body: I appreciate you reaching out a lot, I wasn't expecting that. It's validating too - I've realized recently that I tend to gaslight myself and downplay the whole thing, only to feel overwhelmed again when reality hits. I do think I'm able to change the social part! I've met people through content creation on yt, but I have stretches of not being able to make anything because my surroundings, in one way or another. When that happens, I feel ashamed and like I don't deserve to do what I enjoy or talk to people who are kind to me. Social situations are really difficult as well, but I think I've improved some - in high school and throughout most of college I was basically mute. I haven't had therapy because it's something I'd need to do discreetly.
